title: VyaparVani — build for the way India talks

slides.title: VyaparVani
slides.subtitle: Bolo, samajh gaya, likh diya. A voice-first order and khata assistant for India's 13 million kirana stores — built as a working Docker Compose prototype.
slides.notes: Open with the one-line demo: speak '5 kg chawal Gupta store ko bhej do' and show the confirmed entry.

slides.title: Kirana owners keep stock and udhaar in their heads
slides.body: 13 million neighborhood stores run on notebooks and memory — text-heavy apps interrupt service, so they go unused. [1]
slides.notes: The competition isn't other apps; it's the notebook and memory. Anything that demands typing mid-transaction loses to them.

sources.title: Invest India — Modernization of Kirana Stores in India (2021)

slides.title: Informal retail is the market, not the fringe
slides.body: Kiranas still hold ~88% of Indian retail, and stores are closing under quick-commerce pressure — the cost of doing nothing is rising. [1][2]

slides.notes: The pressure point: quick commerce is eating top-up purchases. Digitized ordering is how kiranas defend share — and that is exactly what VyaparVani makes effortless.

slides.title: Speak Hinglish, get a confirmed entry
slides.body: VyaparVani turns a spoken line — "3 packet surf Gupta store ko bhej do aur unka 200 udhaar tha" — into a confirmed order, Khata balance, and stock update. Shipped end to end: Web Speech + Whisper ASR + Wispr Flow Dictation Mode, inline clarification patching, and 1-tap WhatsApp slips.

slides.notes: This diagram matches the shipped M3/M4 pipeline: Web Speech, /api/transcribe Whisper fallback, or Wispr Flow Dictation Mode -> /api/parse with zod schema, trade glossary, and Devanagari normalization -> in-place Clarify merge or Hands-free hi-IN TTS readback -> Confirm updates Khata balances, deducts local stock, and enables 1-tap WhatsApp slips & Distributor CSV.

slides.title: Downstream dependencies: cost, limits & outage fallback

rows: Typed Hinglish & Wispr Flow Dictation Mode offline; Whisper (/api/transcribe) when key set
15s AbortController (25s budget) + 2x 429 backoff (600ms/1200ms); 401/429/504 errors; no-key runs ₹0 demo parser
Any AI SDK provider / BYOK, same zod contract
Runs 100% locally with zero API calls, rate limits, or cost
Try/catch persistence across reloads + JSON backup export/import; zero DB dependency

slides.callout: If OpenAI, ASR, or network gets costly or stops working: BYOK keeps server LLM cost at ₹0; 15s AbortController + up to 2x 429 exponential backoff guards live calls; clearing or omitting the key switches to the ₹0 local demo parser + Wispr Flow Dictation Mode + offline localStorage with JSON backup.
slides.notes: Nothing is welded to one vendor. The zod structured-output contract means a model swap is a one-line change; SpeechInputAdapter covers Web Speech + /api/transcribe Whisper + Wispr Flow Dictation Mode; StorageAdapter + JSON export/import are shipped; BYOK keeps server cost ₹0; and without a key the deterministic demo parser keeps working offline.
